name: Amazon Leo (LE-04)
location_str: Ariane Launch Area 4 @ Guiana Space Centre, GUF
destination_explanation: A satellite this low sweeps across the sky in a few minutes, so a ground station only gets a short window to talk to it on each pass.
slot_a_text: Amazon Leo, formerly known as Project Kuiper, is a mega constellation of satellites in Low Earth Orbit that will offer broadband internet access, this constellation will be managed by Kuiper Systems LLC, a subsidiary of Amazon. This constellation is planned to be composed of 3,276 satellites.
slot_b_text: Low Earth orbit is anywhere from about 160 to 2,000 km up, where a satellite laps the planet roughly every 90 minutes. Everything there is falling; it just keeps missing the ground.
og_full_slot_a_text: Amazon Leo, formerly known as Project Kuiper, is a mega constellation of satellites in Low Earth Orbit that will offer broadband internet access, this constellation will be managed by Kuiper Systems LLC, a subsidiary of Amazon. The satellites are projected to be placed in 98 orbital planes in three orbital layers, one at 590 km, 610 km and 630 km altitude. 35-40 satellites will be carried on each Ariane 6 launch.
